repository.name: AutoRegLib
repository.description: Automatic registry/loading library for minecraft mods.

issues.title: AutoRegLib missing as dependency in mods that require it
issues.body:
Hi,

While analyzing my modpack, I found that `AutoRegLib` appears to have no dependents according to mod metadata — which suggests it’s unused and safe to remove. However, removing it causes the game to crash.

For example, the [Quark](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/quark) CurseForge page clearly says:

> **Warning: Quark Requires Zeta for 1.20.1 onwards, or AutoRegLib for 1.19.2 and prior.**

But in the `mods.toml` file, only `zeta` is declared:

```toml
[[dependencies.quark]]
modId="zeta"
mandatory=true
versionRange="[1.0-28,2.0)"
ordering="AFTER"
side="BOTH"
```

There's no `AutoRegLib` declared at all for older versions. This means tools that analyze dependencies (like my script) can't detect the relationship and may mislead modpack maintainers into removing essential libraries.

Please consider going through your mods and explicitly declaring `AutoRegLib` (or `Zeta`) as a required dependency where needed — especially for versions where it’s critical for the mod to load.

Thanks!

issues.title: Enchantments and etc. problem
issues.body: Hello. The problem is the following: the enchantments of some items are reset when they are moved to the inventory (for example, today the sword for sharpness 3 and durability 3 has lost all enchantments), the enchantments of ancient tomes from quark and the effects of bamboo spikes from supplementaries are also reset, and animals from cages from the supplementaries just disappearing, enchanted books from villagers sometimes can be solding empty. When I went through the mods, in the end only autoreglib and quark remained - the problem persisted, so I guess the problem is in autoreglib (because it apply not only to quark). The server is on version 1.16.5, and autoreglib for this version has only 47 and 49: we already have the 49th, and the 47th is not suitable, while the 48th just don't exist. Quark and supplementaries versions are the last versions. Do you have any ideas how to solve this problem?

issues.title: Can we use this for Electrical Age?
issues.body:
I'm confused by the license(s). Not being a lawyer, I can't evaluate whether or not it's okay for us to do... much of anything, honestly; I'm only familiar with how GPL/BSD/etc. apply to this situation. So, I'm going to explain what we'd like to do and let you decide instead.

In short:
  - Electrical Age v2 (https://github.com/eln2/eln2) is MIT-licensed.
  - We'd like to link to AutoRegLib using a Maven & CurseForge dependency. It will not be shadowed into the jar. I'm pretty sure your license isn't MIT-compatible, so that was never an option.
  - It's not a dealbreaker if we can't, I think, but we'd also like the option to git-subtree the mod into our repository if we end up needing to modify it, to simplify development while waiting for PR response.
  - Obviously, we'd also like to link AutoRegLib into the same running Java binary as part of running a Minecraft client. As far as I can tell, it also doesn't allow that. (But see "Confused by licenses.")

issues.title: ClientTicker.addAction is broken
issues.body:
Re-posting this as a separate issue since it seems to have been forgotten ([ref](https://github.com/Vazkii/AutoRegLib/issues/33#issuecomment-513530666)).
This may or may not now be causing https://github.com/Johni0702/BetterPortals/issues/395 (might be a mod re-submitting tasks in its handler or a broken `ArrayDeque` due to thread-unsafe access. at least in quark there doesn't appear to be the former).

wrt https://github.com/Vazkii/AutoRegLib/commit/34d20805a2819843d8f6edeb71209b1dd2f9a07b:

> This seems more like a workaround than a fix.
Why is the Runnable `null` in the first place? Is that expected behavior?
It looks like to me that passing `null` to `addAction` can never serve any purpose. So having `addAction` throw a NPE and then fixing the caller sounds like a better solution.

> Actually, upon looking at Quark, I realized that this isn't ever getting called with `null` (might still want to add the check for good measure) but instead it's getting called from other threads and `pendingActions` is an `ArrayDeque` which isn't thread-safe.
**So this is definitely not the right way to fix it.**

> While on the topic:
Why does this even exist in the first place? I.e. why not just use `Minecraft.addScheduledTask`?
As is this will additionally cause compatibility issues with BetterPortals because BP hooks `Minecraft.addScheduledTask` to determine which world a particular runnable belongs to and will then make sure it's run in that context. It doesn't hook the `pendingActions` list so everything will just be ran in the main world.

issues.title: getPickBlock gets the state from the world despite being given one
issues.body:
This usually shouldn't be a problem, but it creates one with Patchouli because it gets the pick block without the block actually being present in the world at that time. It passes the right state, but the state doesn't exist in the world at that moment.
Basically, change [this line](https://github.com/Vazkii/AutoRegLib/blob/master/src/main/java/vazkii/arl/block/BlockMetaVariants.java#L81) to 
`		return new ItemStack(this, 1, getMetaFromState(state));
`

issues.title: When I start a world, it crashes as soon as it loads.
All packets extending NetworkMessage have potential thread-safety issues
issues.body:
https://github.com/Vazkii/AutoRegLib/blob/master/src/main/java/vazkii/arl/network/NetworkMessage.java#L57

Since message replies are broken at this point in time (ref https://github.com/MinecraftForge/MinecraftForge/issues/4231), in my opinion the line above should call to IThreadListener.addScheduledTask to avoid child packets accidentally executing handler code on the network thread.

issues.title: Crashes with turkish locale
issues.body:
Steps to reproduce: start instance with turkish locale(-Duser.language=tr)
Result: crash: https://paste.ee/p/2TxvJ log contains crashes from both Psi and Quark
Excepted result: no crashes

Fixes: start instances with -Duser.language=en or pass Locale.ENGLISH to String.toLowerCase() and String.toUpperCase()
